name: Cayman Island Grand Galactica Corp Limited
summary: Cayman Island Grand Galactica Corp Limited is engaged in the comprehensive research, development, manufacturing, and global distribution of an extensive range of infant clothing and related provisions, catering to markets in Taiwan and worldwide. Its diverse product portfolio features maternity necessities, children's shoes, infant feeding equipment and meals, hygiene and bathing essentials, nursery furniture and bedding, toys, school supplies, home goods, outdoor recreational gear, and gift items, as well as general groceries. Furthermore, the company extends its operations into catering services management, the leasing of factory premises, and various investment activities. Established in 1988 and headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, the firm was previously known as Cayman Tung Ling Co., Limited, officially changing its name to Cayman Island Grand Galactica Corp Limited in November 2022.
